review_candidates.title: Head of Retail Stores & Operations
review_candidates.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Senior Vice President of Retail and Culinary Location: Salt Lake City, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office) About the Role: The Head of Stores is responsible for leading and growing a high-performing retail organization across Backcountry and Backcountry Outlet. This executive will drive profitable growth by developing people, fostering a customer-obsessed culture, expanding rentals and services, and delivering operational excellence across an evolving store portfolio. As the retail business continues to expand, this leader will build the capabilities, talent, and operating model needed to support growth while leveraging AI, technology, and data-driven insights to improve decision-making, simplify operations, and enhance the customer and employee experience. This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility. What You'll Do: Lead and develop a high-performing field organization by coaching leaders, building succession plans, and ensuring the right organizational structure to support a growing retail business. Drive sales, profitability, and sustainable business growth through disciplined execution, financial stewardship, and operational excellence. Grow the business by expanding equipment rentals, services, memberships, and other revenue opportunities while maximizing operational efficiency. Foster a customer-obsessed culture that delivers exceptional service, builds loyalty, increases conversion, and strengthens the Backcountry and Backcountry Outlet brands. Oversee equipment rental operations, including fleet management, seasonal staffing, safety, compliance, and operational performance across all locations. Recruit, develop, and retain top talent while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Establish clear performance expectations through KPIs, reporting, and accountability, ensuring field leaders consistently deliver results and uphold brand standards. Partner cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, HR, Real Estate, and Operations to execute strategic initiatives and support business growth. Champion the use of AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to simplify operations, improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and elevate both the employee and customer experience. Develop and continuously improve operating procedures, training programs, and best practices to create a scalable, efficient, and consistent retail organization. Required Qualifications: 10+ years of progressive multi-unit retail leadership experience. Proven success driving sales, profitability, operational excellence, and a customer-obsessed culture. Demonstrated ability to develop high-performing leaders and scale a growing retail organization. Strong financial acumen with experience managing P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and labor. Experience leading equipment rental or service-based retail operations, including oversight of fleet management, operational execution, and profitability. Experience leading organizational change and implementing scalable operating practices. Proven ability to leverage AI, technology, and analytics to improve business performance, productivity, and decision-making. Exceptional communication, collaboration, and cross-functional leadership skills. Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Salt Lake City area, with the ability to travel frequently. Why Join: The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work. Executive Access: Work directly with the SVP of Retail and Culinary and Backcountry's C-suite to shape the future of the brand's retail footprint. Leadership Opportunity: Build a retail organization from the ground up — define the structure, hire the team, and set the standards across a growing portfolio. Portfolio-Level Impact: Own strategy and P&L across all stores and rental operations, with the autonomy to make decisions that drive measurable business outcomes. Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. Interview Process: Recruiter Screen - A 30- to 45-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the SVP of Retail and Culinary focused on your experience building retail organizations, driving selling culture, and managing multi-unit P&L. Panel Interview - Discussion with cross-functional leaders from Merchandising, Finance, and HR to assess strategic alignment and partnership approach. Executive Interview - Conversation with senior executive leadership to discuss vision, organizational build, and long-term growth strategy. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Salt Lake City office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate. Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly. Please Note: Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately. CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact [email protected] . Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Welthungerhilfe values diversity and ensures an inclusive, non-discriminatory working environment. We welcome applications from suitably qualified people from all sections of the community. Our Code of Conduct Find out more about Welthungerhilfe's behavioural and work principles. Our Projects We fight against hunger and poverty by implementing projects in numerous countries. Liaise with Chinese-speaking team or vendors, or regional student recruitment representatives as needed. Ad-Hoc Event & Student Photography (Secondary Task) Provide secondary photo coverage when the primary in-house photographer is unavailable. Capture high-quality photos for campus events (e.g., orientation, graduation, masterclasses) and student portraits. Perform basic post-processing and photo retouching in Adobe Photoshop / Lightroom or any other tools. The role sits at the intersection of model architecture, inference performance, systems optimization, developer tooling, and customer deployment. review_candidates.description: We offer a deep immersion in bio-based energy technologies; the candidate will learn and live the translational perspective of designing biomaterials for sustainable energy-related applications every day. Situated on the Bavarian Forest gate, Straubing as the old ducal town on the Danube, is the intellectual hub for renewable raw materials and technologies for sustainability in Germany. TUM Campus Straubing for Biotechnology and Sustainability offers scientific and academic excellence in a student-friendly and fresh environment. The successful applicant will hold a 2-year contract with the possibility to expand it. We offer a competitive salary and benefits depending on work experience and seniority in accordance with the public service wage agreement of the Free State of Bavaria - TV-L E13. As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, TUM explicitly encourages applications from women, as well as from all people who would bring additional diversity dimensions to the university’s research and teaching strategies. Preference will be given to disabled candidates with essentially the same qualifications. Your tasks Research on advanced spectroscopic and chiro(optical) techniques and methodologies: time-resolved emission and absorption spectroscopy, non-linear spectroscopy, chiro(optical), techniques, ECD, CPL, magnetic dependent spectroscopy. Participation on courses in the Bachelor's and Master's degree programs and implementation of Bachelor's and Master's theses (English). Development and operation of scientific equipment and methodologies focused on thin-film optoelectronics (vacuum technology, glove-box operation, thin-film characterization) and advanced spectroscopic and optical techniques and methodologies. Assistance in the supervision of PhDs (English). Assistance on the organizational and administrative tasks (e.g. laboratory planning). Collaboration in research projects and involvement in the application for third-party funding. We are looking forward to receiving your comprehensive application, including your letter of motivation (1 page), CV (with complete contact information for two references), complete list of publications, participation in projects, and awards/recognitions in English in a single PDF file, via email to biofunmat@cs.tum.de . Please indicate only “PD_opto” in the subject line. Contact Person Prof. Dr. Rubén D. Costa, FRSC Phone: +49 9421 187-470 Email: ruben.costa@tum.de
